value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. A fever of 38C or higher in a baby under 3 months has to be checked in person, even if they look well.
value.triage: Don't wait at home. Call 911 now if your baby is hard to wake, limp, struggling to breathe, has blue lips, or has a rash that doesn't fade when pressed. Health811 (call 811) can answer questions any time, but don't delay going.
